nameEn: Manufacture of luggage, handbags and the like, saddlery and harness
description: This class includes the manufacture of luggage, handbags and similar articles of leather, composition leather, plastic sheeting, textile materials, vulcanized fibre or paperboard, and the manufacture of saddlery and harness.
includes: manufacture of travel goods: trunks, suitcases, vanity cases, executive cases, briefcases, school satchels
manufacture of handbags, shopping bags, wallets, purses, map cases, key pouches
manufacture of saddlery and harness for any animal
manufacture of dog leads, collars and muzzles
manufacture of other leather goods: belts, watchstraps, leather parts of safety equipment
excludes: manufacture of saddles for bicycles, see 3092
